From the owner
On 2nd September 2002, Mr. Patanjali Keswani founded Lemon Tree Hotels on a simple belief - that the Indian traveller deserved a real promise, wherever they stayed. 24 years and 130+ hotels later, we continue to live it - in the connections we make, the care we give, the seriousness with which we do right by the planet, and the fun we have while making it all happen. That’s the foundation we are standing on, and the one we are building forward from. To everyone who has built it with us - our people, our partners, our guests – ‘thank you’.
